policy: A claim is verified only when the harness executes the claimed operation and asserts its expected observable. Source-string checks, unconditional passes, existence-only checks, and assertions weaker than the stated acceptance are downgraded.

downgrades.reason: The registry contains postcondition verifiers for only trigger_workflow and tasks.create; the README's 'every mutating action is re-derived' is not established.
The harness observes a pending HITL action and an approve 200, but no approved mutation/side effect was executed or re-read. 'Execute only after approval' is not demonstrated.
One HITL row was inspected; a comprehensive actor/action/target/outcome audit trail across governed actions was not exercised.
OIDC config round-trips and the secret is hidden, but login returned 503 and no IdP callback/session was completed.
Autonomy was learned from synthetic observations, not externally verified outcomes from the real track record.
The relaxation mechanism was exercised against synthetic history; the admin/stats surface did not drive a real relaxation decision.
A contract with one accountable-agent field was constructed; no validation/enforcement that exactly one accountable agent is required was exercised.
The alignment sweep was run manually with a fake chat function; the opt-in nightly automation path was not exercised.
One telemetry event was persisted; the incumbency/favouritism/COI report baselines were not generated.
The extraction core was called directly with a controlled model; the agent sync_turn hook was not exercised.
An episode was created and read; graduation from episodes was not exercised.
A span was written directly to the local recorder; request-level tracing and the configured Langfuse export were not exercised.
Goal run create/read/cancel was exercised; resume/restart durability was not.
A starter template was imported; executing the imported template was not exercised.
The lesson was stored and listed; a later task applying that lesson was not exercised.
Provider configuration and masking were read; a route was not exercised from a key stored through that Settings surface.
An unsigned/forged webhook was rejected; a correctly signed webhook being accepted exactly once was not exercised.
